# LLM Engineering Course

> Understand, build, train, evaluate, align, and serve language models

## Docs

- [LLM Engineering Course](https://minigraphx.github.io/llm-engineering-course-pages)

## Agent resources

- [llms-full.txt](https://minigraphx.github.io/llm-engineering-course-pages/llms-full.txt): The full Markdown of every page in one file.
- [Page Markdown](https://minigraphx.github.io/llm-engineering-course-pages/index.md): Append `.md` to any page URL to fetch that page as raw Markdown.
- [JSON API](https://minigraphx.github.io/llm-engineering-course-pages/api/docs/pages.json): Page index of the JSON docs API; each entry links the page's JSON and Markdown forms. Described by the OpenAPI document at https://minigraphx.github.io/llm-engineering-course-pages/openapi.json.
- [API catalog](https://minigraphx.github.io/llm-engineering-course-pages/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of the APIs documented here.
- [agent-readability.json](https://minigraphx.github.io/llm-engineering-course-pages/agent-readability.json): Manifest of every agent-facing artifact on this site.
- [Sitemap](https://minigraphx.github.io/llm-engineering-course-pages/sitemap.xml): Every indexable page URL with its last-modified date.
